purpose: Identify the source of reported information.
keywords: Information source + によると / によれば
According to the weather forecast, it will snow tomorrow.
According to the newspaper, the bridge opens next month.
According to my friend, the shop seems to have moved.
formation: Information source + によると / によれば
restrictions: Often followed by そうだ, という, or another reporting form.
mistake: Naming a source does not establish the information as independently verified.
